lanes.summary: I found nothing that refutes the delta. I judged it from the diff and ran no builds. The delta does what the receipt and the new acceptance criterion say. `KernelBinding.kernel` (default false) is added, and BINDING-006 now keys on (contract, equation, kernel). `find_binding` skips kernel entries, so a reference still resolves to the reference. `contracts/binding.yaml` marks only the oxide entry `kernel: true`. The new test `a_reference_and_its_kernel_share_an_equation` covers all four cases the receipt lists: a reference+kernel pair passes, two kernels are RED, two references are RED, and a kernel-only equation resolves to no reference. The diff shows 16 `kernel: false` literal edits (binding.rs 2, explain_tests.rs 5, readme_gen.rs 1, codebase_tests.rs 2, scoring_probe_tests.rs 2, scoring_tests.rs 2, plus the binding.rs test at ~508), so the receipt's "16 literals" holds. The `contracts_gate.sh` heredoc change keeps the same jq program, its `# probe:shapes_n` marker line and its `$json` input, so behaviour is unchanged. No gate is weakened. The one thing to note is the quorum artifact below; it is not a refutation.

findings.claim: The diff overwrites the prior 3/3 AGREED artifact with a round where lanes 1 and 3 got 429 with no verdict, so `agreed:false`, `partial:true` and `lint.ok:false`. The receipt's 3/3 claim over 367ae45bd6 now has no artifact in the tree, and this file cannot arm a merge. It needs a completed delta round, or the earlier artifact kept beside it, before `--match-head-commit` arming.
findings.fix: Re-run the delta quorum once lanes are available, or keep the 367ae45bd6 artifact under a separate name.

lanes.summary: The diff violates PMAT-4481's acceptance criteria. The first criterion (unchanged in roadmap) states "the only other change is this ticket's roadmap entry and receipt," but the diff contains significant code changes: KernelBinding.kernel field addition, BINDING-006 revalidation logic changes, find_binding modification, 16 struct literal updates, and a new test. A third criterion was added retroactively to justify this scope creep, but it contradicts the first criterion which remains unmet. Additionally, the quorum receipt shows this round has NOT achieved 3/3 agreement (2/3 with rate-limit errors on lanes 1 and 3); only lane 2 (Gemini) succeeded. Receipt lint explicitly rejected the artifact for unmeasured declared models. The prior quorum at 367ae45bd6 may have been valid, but this delta has no valid quorum backing it.
